description: ANM RUCOM Plantas De Beneficio Certificadas is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Agencia Nacional de Minería - ANM, Bogotá D.C.. El Decreto 1421 de 2016, exige la inscripción en el Registro Único de Comercializadores de Minerales-RUCOM de los propietarios de las plantas de beneficio no asociadas a un proyecto minero con el fin de hacer seguimiento y control a la actividad de beneficio de los minerales, la cual consiste en el proceso de separación, molienda ... Coverage: Colombia. The portal files it under the publisher Agencia Nacional de Minería - ANM, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are registro unico de comercializadores de minerales, plantas de beneficio certificadas, rucom, plantas de beneficio. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Minas y Energía. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
